source.title: Thread (Korean): GH_TOKEN set but gh authentication is unavailable, the loader order fixed in PR #770

reason: A four-post Korean explainer of the ingestion credential bug fixed in SlopDotCash/slopdotcash#770: the loader skipped GH_TOKEN and fell straight to the GitHub CLI, so a machine without gh could not start even with a valid token. It lists the corrected read order (trimmed GITHUB_TOKEN, then GH_TOKEN, then gh), the four isolated regression cases, and the boundary of what the public PR proved (config loading up to the GraphQL request, not live authentication). It separates a token error from a loader error for readers hitting the same message, and it is separate from the merged PR, which already scored on its own.
